base.tree_note: The local squashed base commit's git tree is byte-identical to the upstream workflow main head's tree (both 1ff8b943cb8c79c421b20845ea7ed6cf397c4630), so every file:line citation below is valid for the audited head.

method: Read every protocol chapter, schema, validator, test and evidence artifact in the workflow checkout at the audited tree.
Verify each claimed head and its ancestry against the live GitHub API on 2026-11-16 rather than trusting the brief.
Verify CI conclusions for the claimed heads and for the memory-contract PR head via the GitHub check-runs API.
Probe the local runtime (coordinator store, systemd units, listening sockets, launcher state) and record every negative result.
Classify each evidence system into exactly one level of the ladder; no level is taken from a PR merge alone.

classification_levels.SPECIFIED: Normative text and/or schema exists in an inspected repo (or on a named branch); no implementation in any audited default branch; no runtime evidence.
classification_levels.IMPLEMENTED+TESTED: Implementation exists and its named tests pass in this audit run (workflow side) or are named with a proof level in a durable record (upstream side); the audit flags which side it re-ran itself.
classification_levels.INTEGRATED: Two or more components' conformance to each other is evidenced by records the auditor holds: real cross-component artifacts archived in an inspected repo, cross-repo CI pins that ran green, or same-head code on both sides whose contract constants match as verified in this audit.
classification_levels.DEPLOYED: Durable evidence the system is installed and operating on a host, recorded by a party at a named time; not necessarily re-observable now.
classification_levels.VERIFIED-IN-OPERATION: Deployed AND observed working end-to-end with recorded runtime output (an acceptance run, a CI run ID, captured real records) at a named head and time.
